description: Derives the named route inventory from live source and checks it against route_contract.dart identities and the app routers' (consumer_router.dart, host_router.dart) runtime wiring, including semantic nested paths, normalized builder/pageBuilder presentation targets, locally declared block- and arrow-bodied route helpers, direct MaterialPageRoute sites, and a redirect-only exception for retired raw legacy paths. Imported or prebuilt route collections, constructor typedefs, and unsupported full-screen PageRoute forms fail closed through the resolved composition gate. --update writes a copy to the ignored build/generated/route_inventory.json; nothing commits it.
